description.narrative:
The overall objective of the European Union Trust Fund for Colombia, EUTF, is to support the implementation of the Peace Agreement that was signed between the Colombian government and former FARC-EP. This agreement aimed to help the Colombian population overcome the negative effects of 50 years of internal armed conflict.
Building upon the expertise of the European Union and its Members States, the activities carried out through the Fund focus on the early recovery and post-conflict stabilization of the municipalities which have been affected the most by the armed conflict.
The EUTF concentrates on strengthening economic activity and productivity for rural development, supporting public administration reform programs, decentralization, and social participation. It does so by increasing civil society participation and strengthening resilience among vulnerable population groups, such as victims, former combatants, indigenous peoples, and Afro-descendants.

Svenska ambassaden har beslutat bidra till Europeiska Unionens Trust Fund för postkonflikt i Colombia (European Union Trust Fund for post-conflict in Colombia, EUTF).
Insatsensyftar till att stödja genomförandet av fredsavtalet mellan Colombias regering och FARC. Detta stöd ska hjälpa den colombianska befolkningen att hantera de negativa effekterna av en mer än 50 år gammal intern väpnad konflikt.
De frågor denna fond kommer hantera är som följer: landsbygdsutveckling med en territoriellinriktning, stimulering av ekonomisk aktivitet och produktivitet i avlägsna landsändar märkta av konflikten, landinnehav, hållbar utveckling, kvinnligt entreprenörskap, återhämtningsförmåga, statlig närvaro och tillhandahållande av samhällstjänsteroch infrastruktur.

This is a support to a specific-purpose programme and fund managed by the European Union, which is a Trust Fund designed to implement Colombia’s Peace Agreement with FARC. The activities, which focus on the early recovery and stabilisation phases of the post-conflict, will be in line with the territorial focus of the Peace Agreement and with EU priorities and principles, and will build on the experience achieved in this area by the EU and its Member States. The main two topics of the Trust Fund are: (i) the Comprehensive Rural Reform (1st component of the Peace Agreement); and (ii) support to the social and economic reintegration of FARC ex-combatants.

description.narrative:
The EU Trust Fund has heavily contributed to the visibility and success of EU support to Colombias peace efforts over the last six years and a half. The EUTF has been widely appreciated by the Colombian government, by beneficiaries, and by participating EU and nonEU states (UK and Chile).
As of 31 December 2023, 25 contracts are ongoing, including those that have completed operational implementation but are pending administrative closure procedures (pending audits, recoveries, etc.), service contracts and expenditure verifications. As previous years, the results of the projects financed through the Trust Fund are presented in the narrative report, and grouped in six main strategic pillars, including the main indicators for each pillar (targets and progress). See annual report 2023 (KlaraDia UF2015/26964/BOGO192) for full presentation of the results).
Based on the report, it can be concluded that the fund's interventions have been largely successful, exceeding expectations in many areas, especially those focused on peace building, reintegration, and empowerment. However, some areas, particularly those involving support for vulnerable groups such as children of excombatants and the integration of sustainable agricultural practices, require more attention to meet their targets fully. Overall, the fund's initiatives have made a significant positive impact on the communities affected by conflict, contributing to social and economic reintegration, local governance, and the promotion of peace and reconciliation.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
